projects.title: HVAC System
projects.description:
Design and Build Cloud Enabled & AI Powered Heating/Cooling System for Industry 4.0 ( Teksun Aerospace Pvt.Ltd )

We build a cost effective HVAC system for industry 4.0 that can automatically turn on the cooling system for those machines whose temperature rises quick using machine learning and artificial intelligence. This system instantly detects any failure in machine components and informs the owner about the failure.
Also, the authenticated user can monitor the machine's temperature remotely and if the user finds any anomaly. One can remotely turn ON/OFF the cooling system. Moreover, individual can regularly check the system's health. 


The Git-Hub Repository is private, if you wish to see code then message me in-person.
